material_news_signals.description: It's been a quiet start to Jeremiyah Love's career. That's not something the Cardinals running back is used to, but he's ready to embrace the challenge of getting back on track.
material_news_signals.body_text: it s been a quiet start to jeremiyah love s career that s not something the cardinals running back is used to i want to go crazy every single game love said friday via material_news_signals.body_text: chicago in the moment nick sirianni worried what would happen if his offense did not convert and he made a decision he regretted then again he watched the same offense you did when a team is embarrassed in a 27 7 loss on national television as the philadelphia eagles were monday to the chicago bears one decision or play is never the impetus but the most perplexing moment and perhaps most revealing came in the third quarter when the eagles were down 13 points and faced a fourth and 1 at their 49 yard line sirianni examined where the officials spotted the ball it was longer than a yard nearly 1 1 2 and he considered what would happen if the eagles came up short the bears would take possession on their side of the field with a two score lead sirianni decided to try drawing chicago offside take the delay of game penalty and punt in his previous five seasons he had never punted on a play one yard from the marker and between the 48 yard lines 34 as i look back at that i should have went for it there 34 sirianni said 34 didn 39 t like that decision 34 it did not cost the eagles the game but it was part of why the eagles flew back to philadelphia with a 2 1 record lamenting one of the ugliest performances of the nick sirianni jalen hurts era they were outclassed by the bears who started a third string quarterback this was apparent on both sides of the ball the eagles were sloppier and committed three turnovers it was their least efficient offensive performance since sirianni took over as head coach they insisted after two narrow victories that they would not apologize for how they win but the survive and advance mentality of september football is only applicable if there 39 s week to week improvement this loss represented regression 34 i think we all have to own that loss right there 34 sirianni said 34 i don 39 t think anybody coached well i don 39 t think anyone played well that was a true team loss 133 i have to look at myself first we weren 39 t ready to coach we weren 39 t ready to play and that ultimately starts and ends with me 34 hurts understood why specific plays were pinpointed but he was focused on the overall lackluster performance yet certain moments stand out because this game wasn 39 t a 20 point loss all the way through consider the second quarter after the eagles 39 defense stopped the bears at the goal line the offense then drove almost the entire length of the field while trailing by a touchdown bears linebacker d 39 marco johnson pummeled hurts on a scramble out of bounds leaving sirianni irate at the hit deemed late hurts rose and returned to the huddle the medical spotter determined he required a concussion evaluation hurts said he felt he could keep playing and did not suffer any head trauma he underwent his 34 normal evaluation 34 and 34 was just waiting for the thumbs up 34 he said no 2 quarterback andy dalton entered the game two rushes from the goal line were stuffed so the next call was for dalton to throw on third down he threw it to the bears 34 i can 39 t put our team in that situation 34 dalton said 34 costly decision 34 sirianni said he does not get information about how long a player is evaluated for a concussion it 39 s designed that way former giants coach brian daboll was fined last year for going into the medical tent and it 39 s understandable that the process is independent of the coach sirianni considered calling a timeout but he did not know when hurts would be cleared to return and he did not want to burn one he 39 d need it later 34 unfortunate how that series turned out 34 sirianni said 34 practically emotionally and competitively i felt in the right place to go out there and compete 34 hurts said 34 can 39 t just bring attention to that moment there 39 s a whole bunch of other players in the game that hold ourselves very accountable and i think for me situationally i didn 39 t play to my standard i didn 39 t play to my standard so take full accountability in that 34 hurts made his share of errors including an interception on fourth down in the third quarter when it was still a two possession game combined with dalton 39 s interception and a fumble by tank bigsby the minus 3 turnover differential was their worst since 2023 the eagles are now minus 5 on the season only one nfl team is worse 34 turn the ball over you 39 re gonna get your ass whupped 34 devonta smith said the coaches might rest easier if fixing the team were as simple as reducing turnovers the eagles 39 epa drive on monday was minus 1 68 the worst of any game in the sirianni era during a 17 game season most teams have a bad night the problem for the eagles is the issues that weren 39 t rectified after their two wins were more pronounced in this loss three three and outs to begin the third quarter highlighted a lingering problem they 39 re no 31 in the nfl in three and punt percentage this season looking for an optimist 39 s view that 39 s an improvement from last season when they were no 32 they rank no 27 in the nfl in negative play percentage 34 just kind of being off schedule there not being in third and long being in second and long and we have to fix that 34 sirianni said 34 you can 39 t go backwards 34 the eagles 39 average distance to go on second down was actually worse in weeks 1 and 2 than on monday but hurts excelled on third down during those wins they entered the game converting 53 1 percent of their third downs then did it only twice on nine tries once hurts lost that third down magic sean mannion 39 s offense stagnated 34 that 39 s a complete team effort that starts with me 34 hurts said 34 making sure we 39 re in the right play making sure we 39 re managing in a way where we 39 re ahead of the sticks and situationally i gotta play better ball gotta play better ball third down was a very big down for us and that 39 s been a very big down for us in these first two games and today we were not good enough to do this 39 34 barkley said 34 now it 39 s about time we got to do it 34 the eagles have clung to the idea that it 39 s early they 39 re adjusting to the offense three games is a limited sample size material_news_signals.description: The Jacksonville Jaguars have retrieved the football from Travis Hunter's first NFL interception after initially being refused by a ball boy after the play during Sunday's game against the New England Patriots.
material_news_signals.body_text: jacksonville fla jacksonville jaguars cornerback travis hunter ended up with the football from his first nfl interception hunter spun the ball in celebration and then veteran defensive end josh hines allen even screaming hey you can t touch me when hines allen tried to grab the ball the ball boy appeared to try to push hines allen away nfl players are allowed to material_news_signals.headline: Bears' Tyson Bagent clears concussion protocol ahead of Monday's game vs. Eagles; Caleb Williams out
material_news_signals.description: Bears backup quarterback Tyson Bagent cleared concussion protocol and will practice Saturday ahead of Chicago's Monday night game against the Eagles, head coach Ben Johnson said.
material_news_signals.body_text: the bears officially have a couple options at quarterback ahead of their monday night showdown with the eagles backup qb tyson bagent who on saturday was listed as questionable to play cleared concussion protocol on sunday and was removed from the injury report bagent progressed through protocol enough to practice in full during chicago s final practice of the week after missing the previous two sessions nfl network insider ian rapoport and espn s adam schefter reported that while ben johnson initially described bagent to reporters saturday morning as having cleared concussion protocol bagent actually progressed to the next step in the process which allowed him to practice after being symptom free into sunday bagent is in the clear though chicago hasn t named a starter with caleb williams ruled out due to a hamstring injury case keenum is also available and took starting snaps at the beginning of chicago s practice week with williams and bagent sidelined should the bears deem bagent is prepared enough to get the start it would be his first since the 2023 campaign when as an undrafted rookie he went 2 2 for the bears with 859 passing yards three touchdowns and six interceptions across five total appearances he also came in for williams on sunday against the vikings and went 5 of 9 for 54 yards during two fourth quarter possessions if the bears were to turn to keenum the 38 year old veteran would similarly be making his first start since 2023 he went 1 1 that season for the texans throwing for 291 yards one touchdown and three interceptions in what amounted to two of his four starts this decade regardless of who starts they ll have their work cut out for them against a philly defense that ranks fifth in the nfl against the pass through two weeks chicago measures up much better in the run game as the bears enter week 3 sporting the top rushing offense they ll likely look to attack the eagles 23rd ranked run defense on the ground with d 39 andre swift and kyle monangai however the passing game will still have a plethora of difference makers available in colston loveland rome odunze and luther burden as well as swift material_news_signals.headline: Buccaneers QB Baker Mayfield out at least 3 weeks with thumb injury; rookie Jalon Daniels to start
material_news_signals.description: Jalon Daniels will start at quarterback for the Buccaneers with Baker Mayfield sidelined by his thumb injury.
material_news_signals.body_text: for the first time in four years the buccaneers will be starting someone other than baker mayfield at quarterback in week 4 bucs head coach todd bowles told reporters on monday that mayfield will miss a minimum of three weeks after dislocating his right thumb in the team s 23 16 loss to the vikings on sunday tampa bay will start undrafted rookie jalon daniels in mayfield s place when it hosts the 1 2 packers on oct 4 daniels went 0 for 3 passing with a game ending interception after coming on in relief of mayfield against minnesota daniels also gained 9 yards on one rushing attempt the last qb other than mayfield to start for tampa was tom brady back in the 2022 season nfl network insider ian rapoport reported earlier on monday that an mri revealed no ligament or tendon damage to mayfield s thumb the injury occurred on a fourth and 1 play in the fourth quarter on sunday when the qb was hit by linebacker blake cashman as he threw a pass that was intercepted based on what bowles said on monday it appears the earliest return date for mayfield is week 7 when the bucs will visit the division rival panthers it s been a dreadful start to the season for the bucs who are still searching for their first win the 31 year old mayfield signed a three year 165 million contract extension five days before the start of the 2026 season through three games he has the lowest epa per dropback 0 30 of any quarterback with at least 50 pass attempts this season per next gen stats before signing with the bucs after going undrafted in april daniels 23 spent six seasons at kansas where he became the first four time team captain in school history he beat out jake browning for the backup job with a strong showing in camp and now gets an opportunity to spark the offense against a green bay team that just gave up 35 points to the previously lifeless falcons the bucs do not have any other qbs on the 53 man roster but they do have 31 year old easton stick on the practice squad stick is in his seventh nfl season and started four games for the chargers in 2023
